description: This file defines a PHP trait 'HasDataTrait' that provides data storage and access methods, including array access and iteration capabilities, for classes that use it.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the internal data array.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Returns a reference to the data at a specified offset, allowing for indirect modification.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets the value at a specified offset in the data array.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a specified offset exists in the data array.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Removes the data at a specified offset.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the data array.
